storage_crisis_analysis.extrapolated_1080p_10Mbps: 10 Mbps = 4.5 GB/hour = 108 GB/day per camera (decimal units); 5 Mbps = 2.25 GB/hour = 54 GB/day.
storage_crisis_analysis.world_scale: At 1M cameras x 54GB/day (5Mbps) = 54PB/day, approximately 19.7EB/year; at 10Mbps, double those figures. Illustrative arithmetic, not a measured deployment baseline.
storage_crisis_analysis.fv_solution: FV packet records semantic entities and relationships, but this example's packet-only size excludes source video and evidence needed for audit. No storage-reduction factor or evidence-equivalent replacement is established.
